hooks.name: Update footer version after task
hooks.description: After each agent task completes, reads the current branch HEAD hash and last merged PR number, increments the PR number by 1, and patches the .footer__version link in index.html automatically.

action.command: cd /Users/singh/repo/sunveda && HASH=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) && LAST_MERGE=$(git log --merges --oneline -1) && PR_NUM=$(echo "$LAST_MERGE" | grep -o '#[0-9]*' | tr -d '#' | head -1) && NEXT_PR=$((PR_NUM + 1)) && sed -i '' "s|footer__version\">.*|footer__version\">v${NEXT_PR} · ${HASH}<\/a><\/div>|" index.html
